calls.statement:
SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_n,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS utc_date, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03 00:00:00' AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
